svg.aria-label: LangGraph architecture of the invoice agent: ingest, render and text layer, parse, reconcile, extract, ground and normalise, classify document, classify transaction, validate, three paths for standard PO, recurring and PO-less, controls, completeness guard, decide with rules engine then agent review then verdict, human gate, finalise. Left side holds the existing CSV data and the rulebook; right side holds the LLM gateway, the case record and the live UI.
